overview_description.description:
Wajeez is a paid app that provides users with audio and text summaries of nonfiction books in Arabic. The company's current library contains over 3,500 audio and text summaries, with 800,000 users in seven months.

The subscription-based app currently provides content in Arabic with plans to expand into other languages such as Turkish and Urdu.
